description: Search Austrian federal and state law, court decisions, and the authentic Bundesgesetzblatt (RIS).
name: io.github.cyanheads/ris-austria-mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Optional contact string appended to the User-Agent (RIS netiquette asks integrators to be identifiable).
environmentVariables.name: RIS_CONTACT

environmentVariables.description: RIS OGD REST API base URL.
environmentVariables.name: RIS_API_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: RIS document content host and allowlist origin.
environmentVariables.name: RIS_CONTENT_BASE_URL
